transcript.text: panasonic nn h98 not heating anymore, any fix?

On your Panasonic NN-H98, no heat usually points to either a settings issue (like being on 'defrost' or low power) or a fault in the high-voltage heating circuit. Because microwaves contain dangerous voltages even when unplugged, I cannot advise you to open it up; however, we can quickly rule out simple causes. Please check if it was set to full power and let me know if a cup of water heated up during that one-minute test.
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
h98 is what the screen says when it stops, the model on the back is NN-CD87KSBPQ. did a cup of water, stops after 10-15 secs with h98 and the water's still cold

The H98 code suggests a fault in the high-voltage power circuit. Because these are internal high-voltage components that require specialist testing and carry a risk of lethal shock even when unplugged, this cannot be safely fixed at home. You will need to contact an engineer or Panasonic support for a repair.
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
